description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {2}{G}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
